blocks.text: Trade Marks Act 1995
Trade Mark Regulations 1995
Fees are refunded where:
The fee has been overpaid;
Applications or other documents are taken not to have been filed;
A fee is a duplicate payment;
A fee has been incurred as a result of an officer error; or
An inapplicable payment has been submitted by the customer.
All refunds or waivers must be considered and approved by the appropriate delegate, where necessary, before being processed.

blocks.text: Overpayment refunds are identified by Order Management Workbench (OMW) operators and are refunded immediately or queried with the relevant team so that a cheque can be issued by Accounting Operations.

blocks.text: In the case of new trade mark applications which have the correct fee paid but are taken as not filed because they have not met the Minimum Filing Requirements after the two months period has expired, the RIO system will automatically send a refund notification to OMW along with the reason for the refund and the OMW operator will action the refund in OMW so that a cheque can be issued by Accounting Operations.

blocks.text: If an underpayment is not made good, the fee paid is refunded after three weeks by an OMW operator. This refund is identified by the action area responsible for notifying the underpayment and actions the refund in OMW so that a cheque can be issued by Accounting Operations.

heading_path: 5.3 Other documents which are taken not to be filed

blocks.text: If a duplicate payment is identified by the action area a refund request is sent to the delegate for consideration. If approved the request will be sent and actioned in OMW so that a cheque can be issued by Accounting Operations.

blocks.text: If a fee has been incurred due to office error any refund or waiver needs to be considered and approved by the appropriate delegate as per the Accountable Authority Instructions (AAIs) before forwarding to OMW.

blocks.text: Refunds are set up in OMW so that Accounting Operations can generate a refund request. The refund cheque is drawn on Friday after the refund has been processed in OMW and is sent to the payee’s address within the next week.

blocks.text: If a customer has paid a non-applicable fee (e.g., for an extra class that can/will not be added), a refund needs to be arranged.
To organise the refund, email MDB_OMW@ipaustralia.gov.au with:
the trade mark number.
the fee to be refunded.
The reason for the refund.
